disclaimer: All surplus, attendance, driver, offer, acceptance, and delivery events are synthetic. Institution schedule geometry does not imply participation or affiliation.

bakedboston_mip.label: BakedBoston Gurobi MIP
bakedboston_mip.description: Maximizes completed assignments first, then total route quality across simultaneous drivers.

random_feasible.label: Random feasible
random_feasible.description: Chooses randomly from routes that satisfy the same timing constraints.

shortest_route.label: Shortest route
shortest_route.description: Greedily chooses the smallest driving-time burden.

earliest_deadline.label: Earliest deadline
earliest_deadline.description: Greedily serves bakery pickup deadlines that occur soonest.

highest_priority.label: Highest pantry priority
highest_priority.description: Greedily favors pantries with the greatest current priority.

driver_fit.label: Driver destination fit
driver_fit.description: Greedily minimizes deviation from each driver's preferred destination.

selectionRule: The joint Gurobi solve first maximizes the number of simultaneous drivers who receive a distinct bakery pickup. Each bakery pickup is temporarily owned by one driver's menu, while pantry destinations may repeat. Menus are then filled in fairness rounds: every feasible driver receives recommendation 1 before any driver receives recommendation 2, and so on. Each driver selects rank 1.

recommendationAllocation.zeroRecommendationRule: A driver receives no recommendation only when there are fewer distinct feasible bakery pickups than simultaneous drivers or that driver has no time-feasible route.

metricMethodology.actualSelection: Every simulated driver selects recommendation rank 1.
metricMethodology.acceptanceModel: Expected acceptance and likely-rejection measures are prediction-based diagnostics; they do not override the deterministic rank-1 selection used in this demonstration.
metricMethodology.comparison: Policies share identical synthetic surplus, pantry, and driver events. A policy may win an individual metric without maximizing the BakedBoston lexicographic objective.
